mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth, measured by INDPRO exceeding 105, signals robust supply-side expansion that supports corporate profitability and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 105 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in payroll employment and rising unemployment rates indicate a deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth, measured by RSAFS exceeding 365,000 million dollars, signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS > 365000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production, measured by INDPRO below 100, signals a contraction in the industrial sector that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
